body:
LEAD DISPOSITION: ACCEPT. B0-D will bind the future realized receipt to the exact admission decision and declared use, artifact/protected reference, B0-C rule/oracle, C1 schema, D0 adapter, mapping parameters, validator execution, and disclosure policy. Passed is non-transferable, widens no permission, and does not survive expiry/recheck automatically.

I also adopt established-universe accounting as a required protocol state: Established(universe + definition identity) or Unestablished(reason). Under Established, every record receives exactly one closed disposition; missing or duplicate membership yields typed Failed/Incomplete. Under Unestablished, the system may not compute or release coverage, loss, or absence rates. The three receipt-identity/accounting mutations named here become required courts.

This amendment does not create the rejected B0 -> C1 -> D0 -> B0 cycle; B0 still closes on the favorable admission/specification branch, with realized validation downstream.
